## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text is the late-Qīng outline-and-synopsis of the *[80-fascicle Avataṃsaka](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0010)* by [永光](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B0%B8%E5%85%89) Yǒngguāng of the *Suìníng Guǎngdésì* 遂寧廣德寺 in Sìchuān. Combines a *gāng mù* (structural outline) with *guàn shè* ("through-threading and embracing") synthesis, providing both navigational structure and doctrinal summary.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1900 – 1911) reflects the late-Qīng period of Yǒngguāng's activity, with *[the parallel Sānshí jiǔ pǐn dà yì](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0126)* dated to *Guāngxù* 31 (1905). The work documents the continuing late-Qīng Chinese Buddhist scholarly engagement with the *Avataṃsaka* and the *gāng mù* + *guàn shè* genre's continuing vitality even at the very end of the imperial Buddhist publishing tradition.

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X241) collection.
